svg.title: Taxonomy of reasoning generalization in large language models
svg.desc: A left-to-right tree with four pillars: training, inference, architecture, and analysis. Each pillar branches into the sections of the survey and their leaf categories, with representative studies.

Corpus: 233 studies (208 discussed in the survey + 25 from the same screening) • 2023 and earlier: 21 • 2024: 34 • 2025: 68 • 2026: 110 • Updated 2026-10-07
